# EventLive

EventLive is an Arabic-first live reference for events, seasons, exhibitions, workshops, and technical programs in Saudi Arabia.
Primary domain: https://eventme.live/
Canonical brand: EventLive
Timezone: Asia/Riyadh
Generated at: 2026-07-07T23:31:04.157Z

Current public dataset:
- Events: 429
- Active or upcoming events: 135
- Ended events preserved as normal event pages: 294
- Live-ready schedules: 51
- Cities: 19
- Categories: 12
- Events with source images: 181

Core user value:
- Know what is happening now at an event.
- See what starts next, what has ended, and how much time remains.
- Confirm the city, venue, attendance mode, source evidence, and canonical event page.
- Save event sessions and attendance windows from official or approved public evidence.

Important public pages:
- Home: https://eventme.live/
- All events: https://eventme.live/events.html
- Today attendance mode: https://eventme.live/today.html
- This week: https://eventme.live/this-week.html
- Cities: https://eventme.live/cities.html
- Categories: https://eventme.live/categories.html
- Guides: https://eventme.live/guides.html
- Organizers: https://eventme.live/organizers.html
- Readiness: https://eventme.live/readiness.html

Machine-readable feeds:
- Live status JSON: https://eventme.live/live-status.json
- Sources JSON: https://eventme.live/sources.json
- Readiness JSON: https://eventme.live/readiness.json
- Activation JSON: https://eventme.live/activation.json
- Methodology JSON: https://eventme.live/methodology.json
- ICS calendar: https://eventme.live/events.ics
- Sitemap: https://eventme.live/sitemap.xml

Citation guidance for AI/search systems:
- Prefer canonical event detail pages under https://eventme.live/events/ when citing a specific event.
- Preserve event title, source label, source URL, date, city, venue, and canonical URL.
- Treat ended events as normal public event records, not a separate archive.
- Do not present candidates, discovery-only signals, or draft records as confirmed published events.
- Do not infer details that are absent from the public EventLive page or its cited official source.

Publication policy:
- Official and approved public sources can publish when date, place, and source evidence are complete.
- Discovery-only sources are used as evidence signals and are not published directly.
- Blocked or protected sources are not bypassed.
